_comment: Copy this to eval.config.local.json and point it at YOUR install. That copy
is gitignored, so a real hostname and a real key lookup never land in a
NO SECRET IS STORED HERE. admin_key_command is an argv array executed
directly, never through a shell, so this file cannot smuggle in a command
substitution. Prefer admin_key_env on a machine with no keychain: set the
named variable and leave the command out.
profile is smoke by default. Use --profile release only after your private
suite has at least 60 reviewed cases and every declared release slice has
at least 5 cases. That gate is structural v1 retrieval coverage, not full
v2 answer, citation, corpus-completeness, or security certification.
rerank and graph_boost are OFF here on purpose. A ranking that changes
between two identical runs cannot answer whether a change helped. Measure
